title: Agent pane torn-stream corruption fix
intent: Opening the Draft PR with the RED/GREEN and browser-check evidence
summary: Fix implemented and verified locally; the host verification lease is starved so CI is the gate.
progress_summary: Issue #4206 root cause found and fixed. (1) Disproved the regression premise: git merge-base shows the #4095 fix (e782b13b9) IS an ancestor of v9.94.0 and v9.94.1, and all four of its parts are present in HEAD. (2) Found the remaining hole: ClientQueue::enqueue drops a terminal_output chunk at LOSSY_HIGH_WATER but keeps delivering that pane's later chunks once the queue drains, so the client paints a suffix against a screen missing the dropped prefix - the reported character-offset interleaving. (3) Fix: mark the pane torn on its first drop, withhold its stream until a terminal_snapshot re-baselines the client, and keep it dirty so the repair request stays retriable. (4) RED proved by disabling the fix - all 3 new tests fail, and the concurrency test shows a shredded stream (70,71,72,80,81,86,88,93,...). GREEN 18/18. Full embedded_server module 88/88. The #4095 regression tests still pass. clippy -p gwt --bin gwt --all-features clean, cargo fmt clean. (5) Headed browser-check on this checkout's binary in an isolated HOME: real PTY shell pane, correct rendering and alignment in dark and light, zero console and page errors. Committed 1cae58c3a, develop merged, pushed as 6a8a63557.
